meta.name: add-clidash
meta.description: Add clidash — a zero-dependency, read-only web dashboard that derives its tabs and tables at runtime from any CLI that lists resources as JSON. Ships pre-wired for NanoClaw's ncl CLI (agent groups, sessions, channels, users, roles), plus message-activity charts, a log tail, and a read-only file viewer for group skills/CLAUDE.md/profiles.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把任意 JSON 输出 CLI 变成实时 Web 仪表盘
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你经常用 CLI 查看 JSON 数据，想快速获得一个 Web 界面。
copy.tagline_en: Turn any JSON-output CLI into a live web dashboard
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often use CLI to view JSON data and want a quick web UI.

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会添加一个只读的网页仪表盘，它能自动从任何输出 JSON 的命令行工具（如 ncl、docker）生成标签页和表格，并预置了代理概览、消息活动图表、日志查看器和文件浏览器。
howto.when: 当你要求查看 NanoClaw 代理状态、会话消息、日志或技能文件时，或者需要从命令行工具获取资源列表时触发。

say.text: 帮我打开 clidash 仪表盘，看看代理概览。
say.note: Claude 会启动 clidash 并显示代理状态卡片。

say.text: 显示 ncl 资源中的 groups 表格。
查看最近的活动消息图表。
say.note: Claude 会打开活动面板，显示消息趋势。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude adds a read-only web dashboard that auto-generates tabs and tables from any CLI that outputs JSON (e.g., ncl, docker). It comes pre-configured with agent overview, message activity charts, log viewer, and file browser.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to view NanoClaw agent status, session messages, logs, or skill files, or when you need to list resources from a CLI tool.

say_en.text: Open the clidash dashboard and show the agent overview.
say_en.note: Claude starts clidash and displays agent status cards.

say_en.text: Show the groups table from ncl resources.
say_en.note: Claude fetches and displays groups data via clidash.

say_en.text: View the recent message activity chart.
say_en.note: Claude opens the activity panel showing message trends.
